config.prompt: Detect every adult butterfly or moth in this image. Draw a separate box for each individual, even if they overlap. Each box must tightly cover only the visible parts (wings, body, antennae, legs); do not extend boxes to hidden or cut-off parts. Do not box caterpillars, pupae, other insects, or shadows. Output JSON only: a list of {"bbox_2d": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "label": "butterfly"} with coordinates on a 0-1000 relative scale. If there are no adult butterflies or moths, output [].
